valuationPolicy.description: estimatedCashBackRate is a catalog estimate used only for cross-card comparison. Native issuer reward rates remain authoritative.
valuationPolicy.formula: native rate × estimatedUnitValueMinorCurrency = estimated percent return
valuationPolicy.cashBack: Issuer-stated cash-back rates are treated as exact for the earn calculation.
valuationPolicy.pointsAndMiles: Program values are conservative cash/redemption baselines where fixed redemption exists, otherwise clearly labeled catalog estimates.

normalization.categories: Normalized category identifiers are used across issuers; issuer-specific restrictions remain in notes.
normalization.benefits: Benefits contain selected recurring/high-value benefits and are not guaranteed to be exhaustive.
normalization.promotions: Welcome offers and short-lived acquisition promos are generally excluded from rewards unless represented in announcement/benefit notes.
